data.name: Romit
data.gender_notes: Romit is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Romit is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Romah' which means 'mountain'. The suffix 'it' denotes power. Thus, the name Romit signifies a person who is powerful like a mountain. The name Romit carries the meaning “Mountain of Power” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Romit usually hope their child will grow to embody mountain of power and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Romit is a name of divine origin, evoking the power and strength of the Hindu deity Lord Shiva, the God of destruction and transformation. It is believed that those named Romit possess the inner strength and courage to overcome adversity and make positive changes in their lives and in the world.
data.etymology: Romit belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Mountain of Power.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Romit total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

The significance of mountains is not limited to their physical attributes but also their symbolic representation of spiritual power and enlightenment. The name Romit reflects this cultural belief by symbolizing a person of great power and strength.

Mountains are often seen as a destination for spiritual seekers, a place of meditation and reflection. The name Romit can be seen as a reminder of the inner strength and resilience required on the spiritual journey towards self-realization. It inspires one to overcome challenges and obstacles just as a mountain stands steadfast and unwavering against the elements.
